integrity: New claim is an all-cycle-type rational S_n character and its orbit-space quotient spectrum; old star Betti numbers and the kernel/cokernel method are explicitly credited to prior work. Checker is finite modular corroboration, not an all-rank proof.
scientific_limitations: Rational singular cohomology only; standard integral lattice and full arm-permutation group. No integral torsion, ring presentation, or Borel equivariant cohomology is claimed. Earlier unindexed equivariant formulas remain possible.
title: Arm-permutation cohomology characters and a linear quotient spectrum for star nilmanifolds
